headline: Frequent Rework of CSS Styles Module
diagnosis: The file `src/textual/css/styles.py` has undergone numerous revisions, primarily focusing on minor adjustments, documentation, and layout rules. The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates a lack of clarity and stability in the CSS properties and layout handling.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the CSS properties and layout rules implemented in `styles.py` to identify inconsistencies or unclear implementations.
Establish a set of clear guidelines for CSS property usage and layout rules to reduce ambiguity and improve developer understanding.
Implement comprehensive unit tests that cover various scenarios of CSS property application to ensure stability and prevent regressions.
Organize a code review session with all authors to discuss the recent changes and gather feedback on the proposed guidelines and tests.
owner_hint: Ownership should be shared among the authors to mitigate bus factor risks.
